audit_kind: Offline source, board-netlist, build-report and fingerprint audit

board_model.note: Each group of three logical PTP nodes shares one physical user-clock domain on its FPGA.

pad_mapping.rtl_path: engines(0).marker.pulse_o -> pulses_o(0) -> pulses(0) -> observer.ref_o_reg -> OBUF -> U1.U15
engines(selected).marker.pulse_o -> pulses_o(selected) -> pulses(selected) -> observer.pin_reg -> OBUF -> U1.T17

naming_distinctions.component_reference_U15: A DAC component reference; distinct from FPGA U1 package pad U15.
naming_distinctions.TEST_SYNC: Campaign label for intended B2_SPIN_SYNC testpoint; not a literal net name in reference/Obsidian.net.
naming_distinctions.physical_probe_contact: Established separately by campaign source controls; this offline audit does not identify the contacted testpoint.

gpio_constraints.text:
# Obsidian rev 1.1.0 netlist: TP23/TP15 and TP24/TP16, bank 14, 3.3 V.
set_property PACKAGE_PIN U15 [get_ports test_ref_m1_o]
set_property IOSTANDARD LVCMOS33 [get_ports test_ref_m1_o]
set_property PACKAGE_PIN T17 [get_ports test_obs_o]
set_property IOSTANDARD LVCMOS33 [get_ports test_obs_o]
set_property SLEW SLOW [get_ports {test_ref_m1_o test_obs_o}]
set_property DRIVE 8 [get_ports {test_ref_m1_o test_obs_o}]
# Bound register-to-pad latency; these are observed outputs, with no external
# receiving clock. This constraint does not claim calibrated channel skew.
set ptp_marker_startpoints [all_fanin -flat -startpoints_only -to [get_ports {test_ref_m1_o test_obs_o}]]
set_max_delay -datapath_only 8.000 -from $ptp_marker_startpoints -to [get_ports {test_ref_m1_o test_obs_o}]

same_m1_identity.claim: REF and OBS sample the same pulses(0) signal on the same rising edge in one observer process.
conditions: Board A with role 0, first node 0 and configured=1
No reset and stable observation configuration
No pending or waiting transition; ref_owner=1
same_m1_identity.selection_transition_behavior: OBS finishes the old high interval and waits for target low before enabling; transition pulses can be suppressed.
same_m1_identity.common_signal_generation: One epoch marker per logical node compares corrected logical time against its epoch, then sets its pulse-width counter.
same_m1_identity.relative_quantization_conclusion: For stable M1/M1 selection, the common marker cancels logical-clock quantization from relative edge timing. Different logical nodes can select different physical 16 ns clock edges.
